verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an email marketing platform, but the evidence pack never documents per-send bounce, complaint or blocklist signals, or any deliverability guidance. The only reporting evidence is a 'campaign report: clicked' API endpoint, which covers engagement, not deliverability, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see bounce, complaint, and blocklist signals per send and get actionable guidance when deliverability degrades
